{{Top|leg}}
'''The Vortices''' were a trio of [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] musicians, who performed together during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zerex]] secured himself an appointment as the [[Moff/Legends|moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], he hired The Vortices to play at a celebratory party that he was holding in his mansion, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]].
